key.name: save-folder
key.description: Where Ctrl+S puts new captures. Empty means ~/Pictures/Annota.

key.name: filename-pattern
key.description: strftime-style pattern used to name quick-saved captures.

key.name: export-folder
key.description: Folder offered by the export dialog. Empty means the save folder's Exports subfolder.

key.name: include-pointer
key.summary: Include the mouse pointer in captures

key.name: capture-all-monitors
key.description: Screen mode captures every monitor instead of the one under the pointer.

key.name: shortcut-region
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that starts a region capture. Empty disables it.

key.name: shortcut-window
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that starts a window capture. Empty disables it.

key.name: shortcut-screen
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that starts a screen capture. Empty disables it.

key.name: shortcut-record
key.description: Global shortcut (GTK accelerator syntax) that opens the recording setup or stops a running recording, used for the GNOME custom keybinding when the GlobalShortcuts portal is unavailable. Empty disables it.

key.name: record-source
key.description: What the recording setup records: a region, a window or a screen.

key.name: record-system-audio
key.description: Records the monitor of the default audio output.

key.name: record-folder
key.description: Where working files of recordings are written. Empty means ~/Videos/Annota.

key.name: record-export-folder
key.description: The folder the Export Recording window used last. Empty means the recordings folder.

key.name: record-include-audio
key.summary: Include audio when exporting a recording

key.name: gnome-shortcuts-created
key.description: Whether Annota has written GNOME custom keybindings that run annota --capture (used when the GlobalShortcuts portal is unavailable).

key.name: record-keybinding-migrated
key.description: Whether Annota has once tried to add the "Record video" GNOME custom keybinding where its GNOME shortcuts were created before it existed. It is not added again after that, even if the user removed it.

key.name: moved-gnome-keys
key.description: GNOME Shell keybindings (key, accelerator) that Annota took over. They are given back when the Annota shortcut is disabled or changed.

key.name: snap-to-guides
key.description: Moved and resized objects snap to the canvas and to other objects in the editor (sidebar switch, Ctrl+;).

key.name: show-properties
key.description: Editor sidebar on the right; below 900 px it is a bottom sheet (F9).
